description: Method to create a schedule build for a DataModel.

build_type.description: Optional. Type of the build (e.g., "ACCUMULATE", "FULL", "SCHEMA_CHANGES"). Defaults to "ACCUMULATE".

days.description: List of days for cron schedule. Eg.: ["SUN", "MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI", "SAT"] or ["*"] for all days.

examples.user_query: How can I schedule a daily build for the SalesData model at 2:30 AM UTC?
examples.notes: This schedules a daily build for the 'SalesData' DataModel at 2:30 AM UTC using the default 'ACCUMULATE' build type.

examples.user_query: I need to set up a full build for the InventoryModel every Monday and Thursday at 6:00 AM UTC.
examples.notes: This schedules a full build for the 'InventoryModel' DataModel to run every Monday and Thursday at 6:00 AM UTC.

examples.user_query: Can I schedule an interval-based build for the MarketingData model every 3 days and 4 hours?
examples.notes: This schedules a build for the 'MarketingData' DataModel to run every 3 days and 4 hours, using the 'SCHEMA_CHANGES' build type.

description: Method to retrieve all dashboard shares, including user and group details for each shared dashboard.

examples.user_query: How can I see all the dashboards shared with users and groups in my organization?
examples.notes: This call retrieves a list of all dashboards shared within the organization, including details about the users and groups they are shared with.

examples.user_query: I need to audit all shared dashboards and their associated user and group permissions. How do I do that?
examples.notes: Use this call to get a comprehensive list of all shared dashboards along with the user and group details for auditing purposes.

examples.user_query: Can I get a list of all dashboards and who they are shared with for compliance reporting?
examples.notes: This call provides the necessary data for compliance reporting by listing all shared dashboards and their associated user and group shares.
